ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's "I'm Here" / cancellation-button usage for account review (2 upheld no-show disputes, 3 disputes in 90 d).

rejected_claims.reason: NS-1 (i) requires the driver to have pressed 'I'm Here'; the timeline record F7 shows driver_pressed_here_at is null. Even on the driver's own account (F6, tap 17:18:50) the pre-cancellation wait is 3 min 40 s and the chat assertion of waiting 'more than 3 minutes' (F11/F12) is not supported by the system timeline (F3, F4, F5), which the policy says overrides statements.
